release_notes: Code in the landing and offer editors is readable again in light themes (PR #14, thanks @lucasvaz013). The shared code editor keeps a fixed dark surface, but a global form rule overrode its textarea's transparent background with the theme's form background — the fixed light text landed on light (contrast 1.00-1.14:1 in six light themes). The transparency now lives in a dedicated .code-editor-textarea class in the design system (index.css), placed next to the input rule it exempts; ordinary form fields are untouched and the editor stays intentionally dark in all 14 themes.
